injuries.description: fracture of the bone in her left wrist.
source: The Plaintiff suffered a fracture of the bone in her left wrist.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture at wrist or hand level, unspecified

injuries.description: Her left wrist joint will undergo degeneration earlier than the usual expectation. The overall wrist functions will deteriorate gradually and insidiously. This will affect her ability to work.

treatments_received.treatment: Hospitalisation for medical treatment from 3 to 7 August 2008.
source: She stayed in hospital from 3 to 7 August 2008 for medical treatment.
The she received physiotherapy treatments for 10 odd times.
The Plaintiff condition will deteriorate and she will require further treatment and medication. Under this head I award $3,000.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (PSLA) awarded for fracture of the left wrist.
